user.title: Choose your RV Level sensor
user.description: Pick the BTHome device to use. The dashboard needs the Mushroom cards, so install Mushroom from HACS if you have not already.

vehicle.title: Your vehicle
vehicle.description: Measure between the tire contact points. You can change these later in the integration options. The dashboard needs the Mushroom cards, so install Mushroom from HACS if you have not already.

abort.no_devices: No RV Level sensor found. Make sure it is powered, within Bluetooth range of Home Assistant, and added under the BTHome integration, then try again.
abort.already_configured: This sensor is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: RV Level is already set up. Only one is allowed.

yaml_package_loaded.title: The RV Level YAML package is still loaded
yaml_package_loaded.description: The RV Level YAML package is still loaded. Remove packages/rv_level.yaml, custom_templates/rv_level.jinja and dashboards/rv_level.yaml from your configuration, then restart Home Assistant.

mushroom_missing.title: The RV Level dashboard needs Mushroom
mushroom_missing.description: The RV Level dashboard needs the Mushroom cards. Install Mushroom from HACS, then restart Home Assistant. The RV Level sensors work without it.

dashboard_url_taken.title: The RV Level dashboard address is taken
dashboard_url_taken.description: Another dashboard already uses the address /rv-level, so the RV Level dashboard was not added. If it is the old RV Level YAML dashboard, remove it and restart Home Assistant.

dashboard_failed.title: The RV Level dashboard could not be added
dashboard_failed.description: The RV Level dashboard could not be added, probably because of a Home Assistant change. The sensors still work. You can add the dashboard by hand from the dashboard YAML in the project's docs.
